answer: A sybil ring is no haven: a thousand fakes trade only among themselves, which the diversity threshold catches. The kernel: a reward needs trades with at least 10 distinct established counterparties. Each trade leaves a pigment trace, so a cluster stains the same few nodes. A fake posts a 20-credit bond plus 2 credits per trade, so 1,000 fakes pay 40,000 chasing 400, a 100-to-1 loss. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full share.
